title: Riverbend Film Archive | Fundraiser launch memo
titleZh: 河灣電影檔案館｜募款活動推出備忘錄
passage:
At our October fundraiser, we will show short clips from the neighborhood’s film collection. A preview for the public website must make sense without a live presenter and may include only footage cleared for online use. The screening itself can use footage cleared only for in-person events, as long as the presenter explains any clip that depends on outside context.

The two possible previews are the Market Street and Lantern Parade edits. Both have already been tested with viewers who had never seen the original films. They understood Market Street without help, but could not follow Lantern Parade until the host described what happened in the missing opening scene. The music in the Lantern Parade edit has now been replaced, and its entire footage is cleared for online use. Market Street is cleared only for in-person events, though the opening scene by itself is cleared for online use.

Mina has enough time this week either to add a short narration to Lantern Parade or to replace the uncleared footage in Market Street, but not both. Replacing that footage is a substantive change and requires another viewer test. Adding a narration does not require a new test if that same explanation was already used successfully in the viewer test. No testing session is available before the website launch.

Only advance-ticket payments may be included in the amount that the bookstore has offered to match. The bookstore confirmed that a payment stays eligible if a guest moves to a different screening and we carry the original payment across. If we refund the original ticket and the guest later buys one at the door, the new purchase does not count toward the match. For this report, record eligible payments under the screening on the ticket the guest will use; keep payments for canceled reservations out of that screening’s total.

In Thursday’s report, Ellis and Jo were both booked for the early screening and their advance payments had been included in its matching total. On Friday, Ellis transferred to the late screening and kept the original payment. Jo received a refund, then bought a new ticket at the door for the late screening. Both will attend the late screening.
passageZh:
十月的募款活動將播放街坊電影館藏中的短片。公開網站的預告片必須在沒有現場主持人解說時也能看懂，而且只能使用已取得網路公開授權的片段。現場放映可以使用僅獲現場活動授權的片段，但凡需要額外背景才能看懂的片段，主持人都必須加以解說。

可用來製作預告片的有〈市場街〉與〈燈籠遊行〉兩個剪輯版本。兩個版本都已由未曾看過原片的觀眾試看過。他們不需協助就理解了〈市場街〉，但〈燈籠遊行〉少了一段開場，直到主持人描述那段情節後，他們才看懂。〈燈籠遊行〉剪輯中的音樂現已更換，所有影像也都已取得網路公開授權。〈市場街〉只獲現場活動授權，但單就開場片段而言，已取得網路公開授權。

米娜這週的時間只夠替〈燈籠遊行〉加上一小段旁白，或更換〈市場街〉中未獲網路授權的影像，無法兩件都做。更換那段影像屬於實質改動，必須再請觀眾試看。若新增的旁白與試看中已成功幫助觀眾看懂的解說相同，就不用再試看。網站推出前已沒有可用的試看時段。

書店承諾配對捐款，計算基準只限預售票款。書店確認，來賓若改看其他場次，且我們把原票款直接轉到新場次，該筆款項仍可列入。如果我們退還原票款，來賓之後又在現場購票，新購的票就不列入配對捐款。這份報表應把符合配對資格的票款歸在來賓實際持票要看的場次；已取消的預訂款項不計入原場次。

在週四的報表中，艾利斯和喬都預訂了早場，兩人的預售票款也都已計入早場的配對捐款基準。到了週五，艾利斯轉到晚場，沿用原票款。喬拿到退款，再於現場另買一張晚場的票。兩人都會出席晚場。
